description: This PHP source file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class EmploymentStatusSearchFilterParams used for filtering employment status searches within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and adds a specific 'name' property along with sorting capabilities.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering employment status search results, allowing filtering by name and defining allowed sort fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameter object and sets default sort field to 'es.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'name' filter parameter.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the value of the 'name' filter parameter.
